en.t: In the end, matters grew more and more complicated.

units.source_text: 大竹七段声称：不继续对弈了。

en.t: Otaka, the seventh-dan player, declared that he would not continue the match.

units.source_text: 同在箱根时一样，夫人带着孩子从平塚赶来劝七段，还请来了一位名叫东乡的掌疗法医生。

en.t: As she had done in Hakone, his wife came from Hiratsuka with the children to persuade the seventh-dan player, and she also brought in a hand-therapy doctor named Togo.

units.source_text: 大竹七段曾向友人推荐过这位医生的疗法，在棋手当中，东乡早已扬名了。

en.t: Otaka had once recommended this doctor's treatment to friends, and among go players Togo had long since made a name for himself.

units.source_text: 七段不仅迷信东乡的治疗，就是在生活方面，也很重视东乡的意见。

en.t: The seventh-dan player not only had blind faith in Togo's treatment; even in matters of daily life, he placed great importance on Togo's opinions.
Togo was somewhat like an ascetic practitioner.

units.source_text: 七段几乎每天早晨都念《法华经》，有时深信别人甚至到了依赖的程度。

en.t: The seventh-dan player recited the Lotus Sutra almost every morning, and at times he trusted others so deeply that it reached the point of dependence.

units.source_text: 他也是个笃信恩德的人。

en.t: He was also a man who deeply believed in the grace of kindness received.
